svg.title: Leaking wine — a pure SVG animation
svg.desc: A tilted bottle pours red wine into a perforated stemmed glass. The level rises, three streams emerge successively, droplets fall and puddles spread. Six-second introduction followed by continuous flowing detail. Editable vector paths, ellipses, gradients, clips and native SMIL; no images or script.
